product_rule: new system domains are added by exact Lib packages without Rust or JavaScript Host API growth

semantic_authority.physical_binding: exact Lib package native boundary descriptor

platform_convergence.linux: prefer Linux VFS, file descriptors, sockets, procfs and sysfs as the first physical abstraction before adding device-specific adapters
platform_convergence.integrity_is_not_permission: exact adapter identity verification does not create a per-domain grant or allowlist

native_performance.rule: performance may add domain-neutral batching, windows and completion machinery but device protocol and handle semantics remain in the exact Lib

extension_test: a new domain must be expressible by adding or replacing Lib packages while the Host binary and boundary contract remain byte-identical
